product_overview: A dual-sided web system for a dental clinic: public patients can view services and make/check bookings, while authenticated admin staff manage bookings, doctors' schedules, payments and notifications. The system uses local Indonesian formats (WIB, IDR) and supports WhatsApp notifications.
core_goals: Enable patients to register, authenticate, create bookings, and check booking status easily (mobile-first, Bahasa Indonesia).
Provide admin users authenticated tools to create/update/cancel/reschedule bookings, manage doctor schedules (including lock/time-off), and record payments.
Persist full audit trails for bookings (check-ins, cancellations, reschedules), and store notification history for WhatsApp/email channels.
Validate critical identity fields (NIK, WA number) and present dates/times in Indonesian formats and currency in IDR.

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Register new patient accounts and authenticate patients or admin to obtain session/JWT tokens for protected actions.
user_flows: POST /register with valid pasien payload (NIK, name, WA, etc.) -> Receive 201 Created with pasien ID
POST /login with registered credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token and user role
POST /login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 Unauthorized with error message
POST /register with existing NIK -> Receive 409 Conflict or 422 Validation error

features.name: Public Booking Flow
features.description: Authenticated patient selects doctor/slot and creates a booking; system returns booking code and summary.
user_flows: POST /login with valid pasien credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token
POST /booking/create with Authorization: Bearer <token> and valid payload (doctor, service, date, slot, patient data) -> Receive 201 Created with booking code and status 'pending' or 'confirmed'
POST /booking/create without Authorization header -> Receive 401 Unauthorized
POST /booking/create with Authorization: Bearer <token> and invalid/unavailable slot -> Receive 422 Unprocessable Entity with validation error

features.name: Public Check Booking
features.description: Allow public lookup of booking status using booking code or patient NIK without authentication.
user_flows: GET /check-booking?code=<BOOKING_CODE> -> Receive 200 with booking details (status, tanggal, jam, dokter, pasien summary)
GET /check-booking?code=<INVALID_CODE> -> Receive 404 Not Found
POST /check-nik with body { nik: '<NIK>' } -> Receive 200 with list of bookings associated to NIK
POST /check-nik with body { nik: 'malformed' } -> Receive 400 Bad Request or 422 Validation error

features.name: Admin Booking Management
features.description: Admin can create walk-in bookings, cancel, and reschedule bookings via authenticated endpoints; actions update booking status and timeline.
user_flows: POST /login with valid admin credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token
POST /admin/bookings/store with Authorization: Bearer <admin-token> and payload (patient or patient ref, doctor, service, date, slot) -> Receive 201 Created with bookingId and booking code
POST /admin/bookings/{bookingId}/cancel with Authorization: Bearer <admin-token> and body { reason: 'Alasan' } -> Receive 200 OK with updated status 'cancelled' and cancelled_at
POST /admin/bookings/{bookingId}/cancel with Authorization: Bearer <admin-token> for already-cancelled booking -> Receive 400 Bad Request or 409 Conflict
PUT /admin/bookings/{bookingId}/reschedule with Authorization: Bearer <admin-token> and body { new_date, new_slot } -> Receive 200 OK with reschedule record and new schedule
PUT /admin/bookings/{bookingId}/reschedule with Authorization: Bearer <admin-token> and unavailable slot -> Receive 422 Unprocessable Entity or 409 Conflict

features.name: Admin Doctor Schedule Management
features.description: Admin can lock doctor schedules (prevent bookings) and add time-off entries to manage availability.
user_flows: POST /admin/doctors/schedule/lock with Authorization: Bearer <admin-token> and body { doctor_id, start, end, reason } -> Receive 200 OK with lock confirmation
POST /admin/doctors/schedule/lock with Authorization: Bearer <admin-token> and invalid doctor_id -> Receive 404 Not Found
POST /admin/doctors/timeoff with Authorization: Bearer <admin-token> and body { doctor_id, date_from, date_to, notes } -> Receive 201 Created with time-off entry
POST /admin/doctors/timeoff with Authorization: Bearer <admin-token> and overlapping time-off -> Receive 409 Conflict or 422 Validation error

features.name: Admin Payment Input & Management
features.description: Admin records or edits payments for a booking, storing amount, method and notes tied to booking payment records.
user_flows: POST /admin/bookings/{id}/payment with Authorization: Bearer <admin-token> and body { amount, method, note } -> Receive 200 OK with payment record (or 201 Created depending on implementation)
PUT /admin/bookings/{id}/payment with Authorization: Bearer <admin-token> and body { amount, method, note } -> Receive 200 OK with updated payment record
POST /admin/bookings/{id}/payment with Authorization: Bearer <admin-token> and missing amount -> Receive 422 Unprocessable Entity with validation errors
